markers.desc: One of the six demigods. Mandatory boss.

markers.name: Fire Giant
markers.desc: The last known survivor of the war against the giants. Mandatory boss on the path to Crumbling Farum Azula.

markers.name: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
markers.desc: One of the six demigods. Mandatory boss in Raya Lucaria Academy.
loot: Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen

markers.name: Starscourge Radahn
markers.desc: One of the six demigods. Optional but extremely tough boss in Caelid — Radahn's Festival.

markers.name: Morgott, the Omen King
markers.desc: One of the six demigods. Mandatory boss on the Elden Throne in Leyndell.

markers.name: Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
markers.desc: One of the six demigods. Mandatory boss in Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

markers.name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
markers.desc: One of the six demigods. Optional but the hardest boss, in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

markers.name: Maliketh, the Black Blade
markers.desc: Guardian of the Rune of Death. Mandatory boss in Crumbling Farum Azula, two phases (Beast Clergyman and Maliketh himself).

markers.name: Godfrey, First Elden Lord
markers.desc: Optional preliminary fight before the true final boss, at Fractured Marika in the Ashen Capital. Transforms into Hoarah Loux mid-fight.

markers.name: Radagon / Elden Beast
markers.desc: The true final boss of the game, two phases of one fight. Elden Beast is healed by Holy damage — do not use it against it.

markers.name: Mohg, Lord of Blood
markers.desc: One of the six demigods. Mandatory boss in Mohgwyn Palace, reached via the Cocoon of the Empyrean.

markers.name: Divine Beast Dancing Lion
markers.desc: Optional boss in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Found in Belurat, Tower Settlement and in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. A Hornsent ritual known as the lion dance, performed by mighty tower guardians wearing a Divine Beast Head mask; summons whirlwinds and frost storms.

markers.name: Rellana, Twin Moon Knight
markers.desc: Optional boss in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Former princess of Caria, younger sister of Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon. Guards the exit from Ensis Castle, wielding two swords - one with a gleaming stone and one with golden flame.
loot: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight

markers.name: Messmer the Impaler
markers.desc: Messmer the Impaler - demigod, son of Queen Marika the Eternal. «Those deprived of the golden grace shall meet death. In the embrace of Messmer's flame.»

markers.name: Commander Gaius
markers.desc: Optional boss in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. General leading the army of Messmer the Impaler.

markers.name: Romina, Saint of the Bud
markers.desc: Mandatory boss in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Found in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Romina is a Hornsent whose flesh was consumed by the Scarlet Rot; butterfly wings sprout from her back, and in battle she wields a long poleblade and summons crimson buds.
loot: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud

markers.name: Scadutree Avatar
markers.desc: Mandatory boss in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Found at the base of the Scadutree. A giant sunflower with three phases but resistances remain the same. Extremely vulnerable to fire.

markers.name: Midra, Lord of Frenzied Flame
markers.desc: Optional boss in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Found in Midra's Manse, deep in the Abyssal Woods. An ancient sage consumed by the Frenzied Flame; in battle he transforms into a colossal Lord of Chaos, unable to feel pain.
loot: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

markers.name: Metyr, Mother of Fingers
markers.desc: Optional boss in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Found in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr beneath the Finger Ruins of Miir. An ancient being — the progenitor of all Two Fingers; uses magical and holy attacks with giant fingers.
loot: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers

markers.name: Promised Consort Radahn
markers.desc: The final boss of the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Found atop Enir-Ilim at the Divine Gate. Resurrected Radahn, elevated by Miquella to the rank of his Promised Consort; the second phase combines Radahn's gravity attacks with Miquella's holy light.
loot: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

markers.name: Margit, the Fell Omen
markers.desc: Boss in Limgrave, guards the entrance to Stormveil Castle.

markers.name: Tree Sentinel
markers.desc: Optional boss in Limgrave. A mighty knight of the Tree Sentinels, chained to his horse. Patrols the road between the 'First Step' and 'Church of Elleh' Sites of Grace.

markers.name: Flying Dragon Agheel
markers.desc: Optional boss in Limgrave. One of the weakest descendants of ancient dragons. Resides in the marshes north of the Scorched Ruins, appearing when approaching a group of nobles at a campfire.

markers.name: Grafted Scion
markers.desc: Optional boss in the Chapel of Anticipation. Grotesque creatures resembling spiders with human heads and limbs. They are humans transformed through the grafting art used by Godrick the Grafted, and are likely his closest relatives. These few scions of the golden lineage are armed with two slender swords with antique ornamentation and a shield of dull gold with a beast crest.

markers.name: Grafted Scion
markers.desc: Appears in Liurnia of the Lakes northwest of the Boilprawn Shack after killing the Giant Crab patrolling the area. Drops a Larval Tear.

markers.name: Tibia Mariner
markers.desc: Optional boss in Limgrave, Summonwater Village. A ghostly skeleton-like being steering an unusual boat. An ancient grave keeper, capable of summoning Those Lost in Death.

markers.name: Tibia Mariner
markers.desc: Optional boss in Liurnia of the Lakes, northeast of the 'Bridge of Suburb' Site of Grace.

markers.name: Tibia Mariner
markers.desc: Optional boss in Altus Plateau, Wyndham Ruins.

markers.name: Tibia Mariner
markers.desc: Special enemy in Mountaintops of the Giants. Dwells in a massive graveyard west of the large frozen lake, on the hills near the northern fortress.

markers.name: Tibia Mariner
markers.desc: Special enemy in Charo's Hidden Grave, Cerulean Coast. On the river, southeast of the 'Charo's Hidden Grave' Site of Grace. Summons Royal Revenants.

markers.desc: Found inside a chest near the  Temple Quarter grace, located southwest of the Academy of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Celebrant's Cleaver
markers.desc: Location: Altus Plateau Celebrant's Cleaver has a 0.5% random chance to drop from Dominula Dancers that wield it in Dominula, Windmill Village or East Windmill Pasture.

markers.name: Rosus' Axe
markers.desc: Found inside Black Knife Catacombs, located to the northeast in Liurnia of the Lakes. It requires one Stonesword Key to access.

markers.name: Highland Axe
markers.desc: Location: Stormveil Castle The Highland Axe is found directly beneath a large painting of Elden Lord Godfrey and Serosh at Stormveil Castle.

markers.name: Stormhawk Axe
markers.desc: One inside Castle Sol, on a rooftop not far from where you find the Sorcerer Painting. One inside Leyndell, Royal Capital, in the court outside of the Fortified Manor where Abductor Virgin enemies are roaming.

markers.name: Gargoyle's Black Axe
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred right before the Grand Lift of Rold located in the Forbidden Lands.

markers.name: Hand Ballista
markers.desc: Found inside a chest at the top of the Forest Lookout Tower on the Weeping Peninsula, immediately west of the Bridge of Sacrifice from Limgrave.

markers.name: Jar Cannon
markers.desc: Dropped by Demi-Human Queen Margot inside Volcano Cave located on Mt. Gelmir.

markers.name: Albinauric Bow
markers.desc: 4% chance to drop from Albinauric Archers in the Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Erdtree Bow
markers.desc: Found inside a chest that can be accessed by going onto the rooftops near the  Erdtree Sanctuary grace and then to the upper floors, located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Serpent Bow
markers.desc: Found on a corpse partially submerged in a pool of Scarlet Rot within the Abandoned Cave in Caelid.

markers.name: Pulley Bow
markers.desc: Mt. Gelmir Found on a corpse at the top of a siege tower to the west of the  First Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.

markers.name: Bloodhound Claws
markers.desc: Received after defeating the Bloodhound Knight inside the secret tunnels in Volcano Manor that connect the welcoming chambers to the  Prison Town Church.

markers.name: Venomous Fang
markers.desc: Found on a corpse on top of a ledge reached by climbing the remains of destroyed Abductor Virgins inside the Abandoned Cave, located in Caelid.

markers.name: Hookclaws
markers.desc: Found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle, near the  Stormveil Cliffside grace, in the far corner of the lowest room in the western wall area.

markers.name: Raptor Talons
markers.desc: Found inside Sage's Cave, located in Altus Plateau. They can be found inside a chest just beyond a room containing four skeletons, hidden behind an illusionary wall.

markers.name: Watchdog's Greatsword
markers.desc: Dropped from the Erdtree Burial Watchdog enemies that wield it. The simplest grinding spot is in the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. A Watchdog shade is found in the first big open room with a circle of Rosus's light. It staggers when led into the light, making for easy damage at the start of combat. If it is approached from behind by dropping down from the high windows, the two imp shades in the room can be defeated before approaching the Watchdog.

markers.name: Greatsword
markers.desc: Looted from the black carriage directly northwest of Caelem Ruins in Caelid.

markers.name: Troll's Golden Sword
markers.desc: Location: Altus Plateau Immediately southeast of the  Erdtree-Gazing Hill grace, Altus Plateau, in a black carriage within an enemy encampment.

markers.name: Royal Greatsword
markers.desc: Obtained from Blaidd, along with his armor set (except the Black Wolf Mask), when encountered at Ranni's Rise after Ranni the Witch's storyline has been completed. Killing him prior to this will award no items.

markers.name: Grafted Blade Greatsword
markers.desc: Location: Castle Morne The Grafted Blade Greatsword is obtained upon defeating the Leonine Misbegotten at the Morne Moangrave behind Castle Morne at the southern tip of the Weeping Peninsula.

markers.name: Ruins Greatsword
markers.desc: Obtained upon defeating the optional Misbegotten Warrior and Crucible Knight duo boss at the Redmane Castle plaza. Note that this fight is only available whenever the Radahn festival isn't active. If it's currently active, it can be deactivated by defeating Starscourge Radahn and talking to Jerren once more in the chapel just before the lift down to Radahn and then reloading the area, preferably by teleporting to the Chamber Outside the Plaza Site of Grace.

markers.name: Watchdog's Staff
markers.desc: Found on a corpse behind an illusory wall under a stairwell, inside Road's End Catacombs, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Great Club
markers.desc: Received upon defeating Stonedigger Troll located inside the Old Altus Tunnel, in Altus Plateau. The tunnel requires two Stonesword Keys to access.

markers.name: Prelate's Inferno Crozier
markers.desc: Guaranteed to be dropped by the Fire Prelate in the courtyard of Fort Laiedd, west of the  Seethewater Terminus Site of Grace on Mt. Gelmir, which is reached at the end of the gorge starting northwest of Wyndham Ruins.

markers.name: Duelist Greataxe
markers.desc: 4% chance to drop from the Grave Warden Duelists that wield it outside the Royal Colosseum near the West Capital Rampart grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. The Duelists cannot be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. The greataxe can therefore not be acquired after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

markers.name: Dragon Greatclaw
markers.desc: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss guarding the entrance to Leyndell, Royal Capital in the Capital Outskirts.

markers.name: Fallingstar Beast Jaw
markers.desc: Acquired by defeating the Full-Grown Fallingstar Beast boss in a large crater on a peak on Mt. Gelmir, south of the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace.

markers.name: Staff Of The Avatar
markers.desc: Dropped by the Erdtree Avatar south of the Great Waterfall Crest grace located in Deeproot Depths.

markers.name: Ghiza's Wheel
markers.desc: Dropped by the red phantom of Inquisitor Ghiza in the Volcano Manor. He is found upstairs from the  Volcano Manor Site of Grace in the dinner hall.

markers.name: Giant-crusher
markers.desc: Found inside a carriage within an encampment south of  Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, located in Altus Plateau. An Ulcerated Tree Spirit appears upon approaching the camp.

markers.name: Troll's Hammer
markers.desc: Found on a corpse within a shed inside the Old Altus Tunnel, located on Altus Plateau. The tunnel requires two Stonesword Keys to access.

markers.name: Rotten Staff
markers.desc: Dropped by the Putrid Avatar patrolling the bridge in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. The Avatar is visible down and to the right immediately after exiting the chamber with the Prayer Room Site of Grace.

markers.name: Rotten Greataxe
markers.desc: Dropped by a Putrid Grave Warden Duelist northwest of Ordina, Liturgical Town, together with the Rotten Duelist Greaves.

markers.name: Pulley Crossbow
markers.desc: Looted from a corpse on a wooden shack platform at the Craftsman's Shack in Mt. Gelmir.

markers.name: Arbalest
markers.desc: Location: Stormveil Castle Found on a corpse on a castle rampart of Stormveil Castle, along the direct path from the  Stormveil Main Gate to the inner courtyard. It is located beside an Exile Soldier who operates an explosive Ballista.

markers.name: Bloodhound's Fang
markers.desc: Dropped by Bloodhound Knight Darriwil in the Forlorn Hound Evergaol in Limgrave. Blaidd the Half-Wolf will direct the Tarnished here as part of his questline, and will be available for summoning in the Evergaol before awakening Darriwil after doing so.

markers.name: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword
markers.desc: Received upon defeating Magma Wyrm Makar boss inside the Ruin-Strewn Precipice, accessed from Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Zamor Curved Sword
markers.desc: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, defeat the miniboss of the dungeon: Ancient Hero of Zamor.

markers.name: Monk's Flameblade
markers.desc: 4% chance to drop from the Fire Monk enemy that wields it within the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. This is the only spawn for this enemy in the game.

markers.name: Shamshir
markers.desc: Location: Highroad Cave The  is found on a corpse near two Man-Bats in a large, water-filled chamber among ancient ruins within Highroad Cave. The cave entrance lies at the northern tip of Limgrave's Murkwater River, connected to Agheel Lake.

markers.name: Flowing Curved Sword
markers.desc: Location: Consecrated Snowfield The Flowing Curved Sword is found inside of the chest of a Great Coffin carriage trekking through the middle of Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Wing Of Astel
markers.desc: Found inside a chest in Uhl Palace Ruins above a Withered Astel, located in Ainsel River and only reachable from Ainsel River Main. More specifically, from  Ainsel River Main site of grace and head down the tunnel. Take the left split in the road, guarded by a Hardhead Giant Ant, and follow the cliffside path to a stone structure with the chest.

markers.name: Eclipse Shotel
markers.desc: Castle Sol, in the  Church of the Eclipse where there is also a grace.

markers.name: Serpent-god's Curved Sword
markers.desc: Found near a giant Land Octopus inside the Ruin-Strewn Precipice, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Scavenger's Curved Sword
markers.desc: Location: Mt. Gelmir Can be looted from a body at Mt. Gelmir, where all the ladders are, near the Grafted Scion.

markers.name: Mantis Blade
markers.desc: Guaranteed drop: Cemetery Shade in the Gelmir Hero's Grave on Mt. Gelmir.

markers.name: Nox Flowing Sword
markers.desc: Location: Sellia, Town of Sorcery ( Chair-Crypt of Sellia) This item becomes accessible after solving the puzzle and passing through the unlocked gate.

markers.name: Grossmesser
markers.desc: Dropped by Skeleton enemies that wield it (2% chance). They will solely be armed with the Grossmesser. One Skeleton wielding the weapon can be found immediately past the Site of Grace in the Tombsward Catacombs, behind the seal imposed by an Imp Statue, unlocked by a Stonesword Key. There are more inside the catacombs.

markers.name: Black Knife
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Black Knife Assassin in front of Sainted Hero's Grave located in Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Parrying Dagger
markers.desc: 1 can be bought from Patches for 1,600 Runes in any of his locations (Murkwater Cave is the earliest).

markers.name: Miséricorde
markers.desc: Found behind a fog wall that requires 1 Stonesword Key to open, near the roaming Grafted Scion inside Stormveil Castle and the elevator shortcut back up to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.

markers.name: Reduvia
markers.desc: Dropped by Bloody Finger Nerijus near Murkwater Cave once defeated. Beware that progressing through the game can prevent this invasion from happening, more specifically by defeating all the major Limgrave bosses (Flying Dragon Agheel, Mad Pumpkin Head, Margit, the Fell Omen, Tibia Mariner, and Tree Sentinel).

markers.name: Crystal Knife
markers.desc: Found in a chest inside the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel located in Liurnia of the Lakes. After taking the first elevator after the Site of Grace down and walking across a wooden beam it is inside the second room on the right, guarded by two distracted Marionette Soldiers.

markers.name: Celebrant's Sickle
markers.desc: Location: Altus Plateau Celebrant's Sickle has a 0.5% random chance to drop from blue-garbed Dominula Dancers that wield it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located on the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Glintstone Kris
markers.desc: Location: Raya Lucaria Grand Library Received if siding with Sorceress Sellen against Castellan Jerren in Academy of Raya Lucaria near the end of her questline.

markers.name: Scorpion's Stinger
markers.desc: Location: Grand Cloister The  is stored within a chest beneath a massive, scarlet rot-infested statue of the nameless, bearded god of the ancient dynasty within the Grand Cloister, located on the Lake of Rot.

markers.name: Wakizashi
markers.desc: Found on a corpse inside a locked cell in Gaol Cave, located in Caelid. The cave requires one Stonesword Key to access. From the lever that unlocks all the cages it can be found by taking a right then a left, and then it's one of three items in the second cage on the left.

markers.name: Cinquedea
markers.desc: Location: Bestial Sanctum (exterior) The  is looted from a mummified Beastman behind the Bestial Sanctum in Greyoll's Dragonbarrow.

markers.name: Ivory Sickle
markers.desc: Location: Village of the Albinaurics The  is looted from a stone coffin atop a hill at the Village of the Albinaurics, located beneath the Moonlight Altar in southwestern Liurnia of the Lakes. The item is near Old Albus and the  Village of the Albinaurics site of grace. Beware the Depraved Perfumer.

markers.name: Erdsteel Dagger
markers.desc: Received from Kenneth Haight after helping him retake Fort Haight. Can be found in Leyndell, Royal Capital in the sewer area under the wing of Gransax near a fire-spitting Gargoyle Statue. From the Avenue Balcony Site of Grace, proceed northwest along the avenue and drop down in the pit to the far left.

markers.name: Blade Of Calling
markers.desc: Loot: Forbidden Lands Hidden within a room that you can only reach during the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace, alongside the Official's Attire.

markers.name: Bloodstained Dagger
markers.desc: 2% drop rate from Fierce Demi-Humans aka Demi-Human Chiefs. One can point asleep next to the bridge west of the South of the Lookout Tower Site of Grace.

markers.name: Nightrider Flail
markers.desc: Drop from the Weeping Peninsula Night's Cavalry, found near the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace at night.

markers.name: Flail
markers.desc: Found at Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage furthest east from Gatefront's marker. Also dropped by Brother Corhyn at his death or at the end of his questline.

markers.name: Family Heads
markers.desc: Received upon defeating Necromancer Garris, who is found behind an illusory wall inside the Sage's Cave, located in Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Crystal Staff
markers.desc: Found in a treasure chest inside the Academy Crystal Cave, located near the Crystalline Woods grace, in Liurnia of the Lakes. The cave requires 2 Stonesword Keys to enter. The chest is behind an illusory wall to the left after entering the room with a Battlemage.

markers.name: Gelmir Glintstone Staff
markers.desc: 10% chance to be dropped by the shell-helmed Gelmir Man-Serpent in the throne room of Volcano Manor, right before the sending gate leading to Rykard's area.

markers.name: Digger's Staff
markers.desc: 2% chance to be dropped by various Glintstone Miners like those in Sellia Crystal Tunnel, located in Caelid. The larger variant has a 4% chance to drop it.

markers.name: Albinauric Staff
markers.desc: Location: Volcano Manor (Prison Town) The  is found on a corpse at the Prison Town of the Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir, near the  Guest Hall site of grace.

markers.name: Academy Glintstone Staff
markers.desc: Dropped by Thops, either by killing him in the Church of Irith or upon finishing his questline, inside the Academy of Raya Lucaria near the Schoolhouse Classroom site of grace. 2% chance to be dropped by various Glintstone Sorcerers that wield it.

markers.name: Azur's Glintstone Staff
markers.desc: Found in a secluded room on the highest level of the Church of the Cuckoo. The level can be accessed via the rooftops of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. From the Debate Parlor site of grace, go outside to the left until you meet two Raya Lucaria Sorcerers. Jump down on the stairs next to them. Continue forward until you can jump onto the rooftops. Then, proceed further and go up the ladder at the end of said rooftops.

markers.name: Staff Of The Guilty
markers.desc: 2.00% chance to be dropped by Guilty Sorcerers that wield this weapon, such as the ones near the Seethewater Terminus grace, located in Mt. Gelmir. ? % chance to drop from Guilty in .

markers.name: Rotten Crystal Staff
markers.desc: 8% chance to be dropped by Putrid Crystalian Mages such as the one near the Elphael Inner Wall grace, located in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree. Another Putrid Crystalian Mage can be found by going down to the lower eastern rampart where a Rotten Avatar patrols and running north up the stairs and into the building. Since there are no spear-wielding Crystalians nearby and the Avatar does not respawn, it can be safer to grind for the staff from this one instead of the one in the inner wall. If you are simultaneously grinding for the Rotten Crystal Spear, however, the Inner Wall grace is better.

markers.name: Great Omenkiller Cleaver
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Omenkiller & Miranda the Blighted Bloom duo boss inside the Perfumer's Grotto located in Altus Plateau. Dropped from the Omenkiller in Volcano Manor. He stands near a crematory pyre in the middle of the collection of buildings to the right after exiting the  Prison Town Church.

markers.name: Rusted Anchor
markers.desc: Dropped by the Scaly Misbegotten area boss in Morne Tunnel.

markers.name: Gargoyle's Great Axe
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Valiant Gargoyle found on the stairway northeast of the  Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace, located in the Capital Outskirts.

markers.name: Erdtree Greatbow
markers.desc: Received upon destroying the Merciless Chariot within the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. You must use a ranged weapon to shoot a wire, causing explosive great jars to drop. You have limited attempts and must time your shot.

markers.name: Greatbow
markers.desc: Found inside a chest on top of the Highway Lookout Tower located in northeastern Altus Plateau. 4% chance to drop from various bow-wielding Knights.

markers.name: Siluria's Tree
markers.desc: Received upon defeating Crucible Knight Siluria at the Deeproot Depths. She guards a giant hollow tree trunk to the southwest of the Nameless Eternal City.

markers.name: Vyke's War Spear
markers.desc: Received upon defeating Festering Fingerprint Vyke at the Church of Inhibition in northeastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Serpent-hunter
markers.desc: Mt. Gelmir (Volcano Manor) Loot: Can be picked up within the boss arena of Praetor Rykard, just after the fog gate.

markers.name: Lance
markers.desc: Found on a corpse on top of a fallen ruin by a camp, northeast of the Warmaster's Shack located in Limgrave.

markers.name: Treespear
markers.desc: Found inside a chest in a carriage on a collapsed bridge south of the Liurnia Highway South Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Bastard Sword
markers.desc: Nomadic Merchant at Castle Morne Rampart in the Weeping Peninsula region.

markers.name: Forked Greatsword
markers.desc: Wolf Head Imp golems have a 2% chance (at 100 discovery) to drop this weapon. One such Imp can be found immediately near the Site of Grace in the Road's End Catacombs.

markers.name: Lordsworn's Greatsword
markers.desc: Found at Gatefront Ruins, located in the black carriage closest to Gatefront's marker, just to the west.

markers.name: Alabaster Lord's Sword
markers.desc: Location: Lake of Rot Defeat the Alabaster Lord in the Lake of Rot (will not drop if the Lord is killed at the same time as the player) to obtain the . He is on top of a large Ancient Dynasty structure.

markers.name: Helphen's Steeple
markers.desc: Dropped by a Tibia Mariner on the Mountaintops of the Giants, near Castle Sol, not far from the  Snow Valley Ruins Overlook grace and where you fight the Death Rite Bird.

markers.name: Golden Order Greatsword
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Misbegotten Crusader in Cave of the Forlorn, located in the Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Gargoyle's Blackblade
markers.desc: Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred guarding the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid. ru:Чёрный двуручник горгулий

markers.name: Lucerne
markers.desc: Found north of the  Liurnia Highway North grace in Liurnia of the Lakes, near a broken carriage in an old battlefield.

markers.name: Banished Knight's Halberd
markers.desc: +8 version dropped by Edgar when he is killed either at Castle Morne or at the Revenger's Shack. 4% chance to be dropped by Banished Knights that wield it. One can be found near the Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.

markers.name: Nightrider Glaive
markers.desc: Dropped alongside the Ash of War: Giant Hunt by a Night's Cavalry miniboss in Liurnia of the Lakes, who patrols immediately north of the  East Raya Lucaria Gate grace where the Finger Reader Crone is. The cavalry only spawns during nighttime.

markers.name: Golden Halberd
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Tree Sentinel between the Stranded Graveyard and the Church of Elleh in Limgrave.

markers.name: Glaive
markers.desc: 4% chance to be dropped by Skeletal Executioners that wield it, such as the one near the  Sellia Backstreets grace in Sellia, Town of Sorcery.

markers.name: Guardian's Swordspear
markers.desc: 2% chance to be dropped by Erdtree Guardians found near Minor Erdtrees or on the roots leading to the  Erdtree Sanctuary in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Dragon Halberd
markers.desc: Dropped by the Dragonkin Soldier in the lower Siofra River region. It is reached either by going through a Sending Gate found on top of a crumbled pillar on the eastern side of lower Siofra, just south of the  Worshippers' Woods grace. Alternatively, it may be reached by going all the way across the bridge from the Mimic Tear grace in Nokron, Eternal City and carefully dropping down the ledges on the building.

markers.name: Gargoyle's Halberd
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Valiant Gargoyle near the  West Capital Rampart grace, located in Leyndell.

markers.name: Gargoyle's Black Halberd
markers.desc: Dropped upon defeating the Black Blade Kindred guarding the Bestial Sanctum in Caelid.

markers.name: Warpick
markers.desc: 2% chance to drop from Godrick Soldiers that wield it, such as those in Stormhill near the Castleward Tunnel or Mt. Gelmir near the First Mt. Gelmir Campsite.

markers.name: Varré's Bouquet
markers.desc: Mohgwyn Palace (Dynasty Mausoleum Entrance) Drop: Defeat White Mask Varré at the end of his questline.

markers.name: Morning Star
markers.desc: Found in a chest in a broken down carriage down the road to the south of Bridge of Sacrifice and Irina in the Weeping Peninsula region.

markers.name: Scepter Of The All-knowing
markers.desc: Dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing within the  Erdtree Sanctuary in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

markers.name: Nox Flowing Hammer
markers.desc: Found on a corpse in Night's Sacred Ground, located in Nokron, Eternal City. It is found on a stone arch in the same building as the Black Whetblade and the Mimic Tear Ashes.

markers.name: Ringed Finger
markers.desc: Location: Gelmir Hero's Grave The Ringed Finger is found in a chest inside the Gelmir Hero's Grave, located on Mt. Gelmir. The chest is at the very bottom of the first lava-filled ramp in the grave, in an alcove to the left.

markers.name: Bloody Helice
markers.desc: Writheblood Ruins, north of the Second Church of Marika in the Altus Plateau. It will be in a chest behind the Sanguine Noble miniboss.

markers.name: Great Épée
markers.desc: Found inside a chest east of the Agheel Lake South grace located in Limgrave.

markers.name: Godskin Stitcher
markers.desc: Location: Temple of Eiglay Received upon defeating the Godskin Noble boss guarding the Serpent's Amnion in the Temple of Eiglay, located at in Volcano Manor on Mt. Gelmir.

markers.name: Rivers Of Blood
markers.desc: Defeat Okina at the Church of Repose.

markers.name: Moonveil
markers.desc: Defeat the Magma Wyrm in Gael Tunnel.

markers.name: Serpentbone Blade
markers.desc: Obtained from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress after defeating Rileigh the Idle.

markers.name: Misbegotten Shortbow
markers.desc: 2% chance to drop from Winged Misbegotten enemies. A group of three can be found near the Ailing Village, along the cliffs just southeast of the  Ailing Village Outskirts Site of Grace.

markers.name: Harp Bow
markers.desc: Gained upon approaching the Painter Spirit on top of a cliff east of Sainted Hero's Grave, located in Altus Plateau. Requires having examined the "Champion's Song" Painting in the Shaded Castle.

markers.name: Scythe
markers.desc: Location: Cliffbottom Catacombs The  is found at the Cliffbottom Catacombs, located in the southeastern section of Liurnia of the Lakes. It is looted from a corpse guarded by four stone Imps on the upper level.

markers.name: Winged Scythe
markers.desc: Location: Tombsward Ruins The Winged Scythe is found in a treasure chest in the underground cellar at the Tombsward Ruins, located on the western Weeping Peninsula.

markers.name: Giant's Seal
markers.desc: Found near a Fire Prelate enemy inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave located in Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.name: Clawmark Seal
markers.desc: Received after feeding 1 Deathroot to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman inside the Bestial Sanctum located in Caelid.

markers.name: Golden Order Seal
markers.desc: Found inside the Minor Erdtree Church, located between the two ramparts of Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Erdtree Seal
markers.desc: Found inside a open cell down the town near the Prison Town Church grace, located in Volcano Manor. There is a Omenkiller enemy near it.

markers.name: Dragon Communion Seal
markers.desc: Dropped by a spectral Banished Knight located in the Fringefolk Hero's Grave in Limgrave. To find it, start at the Stranded Graveyard Site of Grace and head down the first two ramps in the Grave, then head right in the split to go up another two ramps. The Knight is inside a small room at the end of the ramp and is quite tough for the early game. The Chariot in the dungeon can be used to help kill it, though that comes at considerable risk to the player as well.

markers.name: Spear
markers.desc: 2% chance to be dropped from the Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle. A +7 version is dropped by Patches if he is killed, whether at his original spot in Murkwater Cave or at any point of his questline.

markers.name: Crystal Spear
markers.desc: Location: Sellia Hideaway, Caelid Found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in the large crystal-pierced room just before the tunnel leading to the boss room.

markers.name: Partisan
markers.desc: 4% chance to be dropped from Knight enemies that wield it, such as the Godrick Knight in the Gatefront Ruins in Limgrave, or the two Leyndell Knight near the Ninth Mt. Gelmir Campsite grace in Mt. Gelmir.

markers.name: Celebrant's Rib-rake
markers.desc: Location: Altus Plateau Celebrant's Rib-Rake has a 0.5% chance to drop from Dominula Dancers that wield it in Dominula, Windmill Village or East Windmill Pasture.

markers.name: Bolt Of Gransax
markers.desc: Located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Exit the Erdtree Sanctuary and descend with the elevator, then jump over the street railing and down onto the building below. The spear is on top of its gigantic version.

markers.name: Cross-naginata
markers.desc: Looted from a corpse in the Gael Tunnel. After leaving the Site of Grace, turn right into a side-passage leading to a large cavern guarded by a Land Octopus. The item is on the chamber's far end.

markers.name: Death Ritual Spear
markers.desc: Location: Mountaintops of the Giants The  is dropped by the Death Rite Bird on the Mountaintops of the Giants, located on the cliffs just southwest of Castle Sol. It appears even during the day. The nearby Tibia Mariner drops Helphen's Steeple.

markers.name: Inquisitor's Girandole
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Abductor Virgin duo boss at the end of the Subterranean Inquisition Chamber of Volcano Manor.

markers.name: Iron Spear
markers.desc: 2% chance to be dropped by the spear-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers found through the upper plaza of Nokron, Eternal City and the Siofra Aqueduct.

markers.name: Winged Spear
markers.desc: 2% chance to be dropped from the Exile Soldiers that wield it in Stormveil Castle. A +7 version is dropped by Patches if he is killed, whether at his original spot in Murkwater Cave or at any point of his questline.

markers.name: Weathered Straight Sword
markers.desc: Dropped by Commoner enemies with a 4% drop rate. An easy spot to farm is the room with a Grafted Scion, where 3 Commoners are sitting next to a fireplace near the stairs to the second floor (an easy path there is taking the elevator next to the Rampart Tower Site of Grace).

markers.name: Ornamental Straight Sword
markers.desc: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation, either by beating it first try when starting the game or when visiting again through The Four Belfries in west Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Sword Of Night And Flame
markers.desc: In a locked room at Caria Manor, Liurnia of the Lakes, which the Tarnished can jump into from above on the walkways where the Raya Lucaria Soldier puppets appear. More specifically, starting from the Manor Lower Level Site of Grace walk out onto the stone walkways and take a left when they path splits in two. Follow the path as it turn to the right and look to the left when halfway across the last walkway. Search for a nearby roof to jump onto and then walk forward to find another roof further down. In one of the corners should be a ladder leading down into the inside of a tower with a chest c

markers.name: Carian Knight's Sword
markers.desc: Held by a Carriage located in the northwest region of Liurnia of the Lakes, between the Northern Liurnia Lake Shore and The Four Belfries Sites of Grace.

markers.name: Crystal Sword
markers.desc: Found after the bridge in the Village of the Albinaurics Site of Grace, located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Sword Of St Trina
markers.desc: Behind a Stonesword Key imp statue in the Forsaken Ruins, Caelid, visible directly below the ledge at the Rotview Balcony Site of Grace.

markers.name: Miquellan Knight's Sword
markers.desc: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, near the  Prayer Room Site of Grace. After exiting the Grace in it to continue forward there will be a parapet on the right that leads to a tower with a ladder on the other side. Climbing that ladder leads to the sword's location.

markers.name: Cane Sword
markers.desc: Found next to the stairs just south of the  West Capital Rampart Site of Grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

markers.name: Regalia Of Eochaid
markers.desc: On a ledge at the beach bordering Caelid and Limgrave, to the east of the Third Church of Marika. It can be reached through the Gaol Cave or by using Torrent to perform some tricky jumps to ascend the cliff face onto its ledge.

markers.name: Noble's Slender Sword
markers.desc: Dropped by Wandering Nobles that wield it with a 0.5% drop rate. These specific nobles are distinguished by wearing the Aristocrat Garb (Altered) and Aristocrat Boots.

markers.name: Warhawk's Talon
markers.desc: Dropped by Warhawks in Stormveil Castle with a 2% drop rate. 4 of these birds can be found on the walls outside of the Rampart Tower Site of Grace.

markers.name: Lazuli Glintstone Sword
markers.desc: Dropped by Lazuli Glintstone Sorcerers with a 2% drop rate. One can be easily reached just outside of the room with the Schoolhouse Classroom Site of Grace, just before the Red Wolf of Radagon in Academy of Raya Lucaria.

markers.name: Rogier's Rapier
markers.desc: Obtained from Sorcerer Rogier in Roundtable Hold after defeating Godrick the Grafted.

markers.name: Torch
markers.desc: Bought from Merchant Kalé for  200 runes.

markers.name: Noble's Estoc
markers.desc: Chance (0,5%) to drop from Wandering Noble enemies that wield it, specifically the ones wearing the Aristocrat Hat and Aristocrat Coat. There are two immediately to the north of the Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace, following a torch bearer.

markers.name: St. Trina's Torch
markers.desc: Location: Consecrated Snowfield St. Trina's Torch is found inside a wandering Great Coffin caravan in the southeastern Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Ghostflame Torch
markers.desc: Location: Nokron, Eternal City The  is found on a corpse on the narrow rooftops near the entrance of Nokron, Eternal City.

markers.name: Sentry's Torch
markers.desc: Bought from the Hermit Merchant for 7000 runes in Altus Plateau near the first rampart of the capital.

markers.name: Godskin Peeler
markers.desc: Defeat the Godskin Apostle at Dominula, Windmill Village in the northern Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Twinned Knight Swords
markers.desc: Found on a corpse near the East Windmill Pasture located in Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Eleonora's Poleblade
markers.desc: Defeating Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger at the Second Church of Marika in the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Gargoyle's Black Blades
markers.desc: Received upon defeating Black Blade Kindred before the Grand Lift of Rold.

markers.name: Large Club
markers.desc: Found on a corpse on a cliff near a group of Demi-Human enemies in a forested area south of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol, located in Limgrave.

markers.name: Battle Hammer
markers.desc: 4% chance to be dropped by Grave Warden Duelists outside the Royal Colosseum in Leyndell, Royal Capital. The Duelists cannot be found in Leyndell, Ashen Capital. The hammer can therefore not be acquired after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

markers.name: Great Mace
markers.desc: Found inside a chest around the trebuchets before the Grand Lift of Dectus in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Celebrant's Skull
markers.desc: Location: Altus Plateau Looted from a corpse on a cliff ledge to the northeast of the Windmill Village Site of Grace within Dominula, Windmill Village.

markers.name: Cranial Vessel Candlestand
markers.desc: Mountaintops of the Giants, Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, behind the second imp statue in the dungeon.

markers.name: Great Stars
markers.desc: Found inside a carriage pulled by Trolls on a route between the  Road of Iniquity Side Path grace and the Writheblood Ruins located in Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Brick Hammer
markers.desc: Location: Stormveil Castle The  is found on a corpse in Stormveil Castle in the area within the wall past the  Stormveil Cliffside site of grace. It is accessed by climbing the ladder behind the door unlocked by the Rusty Key and turning right to jump across the gap, crossing the beams, and then jumping to another platform leading to an opening in the wall. Follow the path outside and reenter at the round tower. The corpse hangs from a ledge.

markers.name: Rotten Battle Hammer
markers.desc: Dropped by a Putrid Grave Warden Duelist located west of the Consecrated Snowfield grace.

markers.name: Magma Whip Candlestick
markers.desc: Reward from Patches in Volcano Manor after defeating Great Horned Tragoth. Won't be given the first time he is spoken too. Instead, the area has to be reloaded in some way (either via teleporting or by exiting and re-entering the game) and he can be spoken to again to gain the weapon.

markers.name: Hoslow's Petal Whip
markers.desc: Dropped by Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood after invading him at the Shack of the Lofty on the Mountaintops of the Giants. The invasion sign appears after receiving the Red Letter, the final contract from Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress.

markers.name: Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword
markers.desc: Location: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past The Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword is obtained upon examining the forge altar at the Ruined Forge Starfall Past.

markers.name: Anvil Hammer
markers.desc: This weapon can be found and obtained at the altar at the end of the Ruined Forge Lava Intake.

markers.name: Backhand Blade
markers.desc: This weapon can be found beside a coffin, in the Inquisitor enemies' area of Gravesite Plain, northeast from the  Scorched Ruins site of grace.

markers.name: Beast Claw (weapon)
markers.desc: This weapon is dropped from Logur, the Beast Claw, in the southern area of Gravesite Plains, on the way to the Church of Consolation from the Gravesite Plain site of grace.

markers.name: Black Steel Greathammer
markers.desc: Guaranteed drop from the Black Knight found in the Church of Consolation at the end of the downhill path east of the Gravesite Plain Site of Grace.

markers.name: Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear
markers.desc: Guaranteed drop from a Bloodfiend Hexer in Rauh Base. It can be found in a shallow pond to the west of Taylew's Ruined Forge.

markers.name: Bone Bow
markers.desc: Location: Belurat, Tower Settlement The  is found on a corpse in the Upper Residential Ward of Belurat, Tower Settlement. From the  Belurat, Tower Settlement site of grace, turn left and ascend the elevator shortcut, then turn left again to enter the bottom of the spiral staircase tower. The bow is on the other side of the room, guarded by numerous Baby Spider Scorpions and two Large Spider Scorpions.

markers.name: Bonny Butchering Knife
markers.desc: The weapon can be found at Bonny Village below a small shed outside a house, near the broken bridge.

markers.name: Chilling Perfume Bottle
markers.desc: Found on a corpse inside the Lamenter's Gaol.

markers.name: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe
markers.desc: This weapon is dropped after defeating the Death Knight of the Scorpion River Catacombs.

markers.name: Death Knight's Twin Axes
markers.desc: Location: Fog Rift Catacombs Dropped by the Death Knight boss.

markers.name: Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana
markers.desc: Location: Dragon's Pit The Dragon-Hunter's Great Katana is obtained upon defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man at the bottom of the Dragon's Pit.

markers.name: Dryleaf Arts
markers.desc: Dropped by Dryleaf Dane after the spar at Moorth Ruins.

markers.name: Dryleaf Seal
markers.desc: Found on a corpse near the  Recluses' River Downstream Site of Grace. Go north until you find a ledge with several Gravebirds. The seal lies on a ledge just below Dane's message.

markers.name: Euporia
markers.desc: This armament can be found in Belurat, Tower Settlement. However, reaching it can only be done through Enir-Ilim. On the stairs past the lightning-aspected Divine Beast Warrior, jump off the path onto a lower staircase and then follow the ledges down until you reach a platform with a Fireproof Pickled Liver. Jump into the nearby window (sprinting is advised), and then go out to the balcony and follow the path to the right down the lifts, past the Inquisitors and the Divine Beast Warrior. Euporia lies at the end of this path.

markers.name: Firespark Perfume Bottle
markers.desc: Found inside a chest inside a tent in the camp near the  Castle Front site of grace before Castle Ensis.

markers.name: Flowerstone Gavel
markers.desc: Location: Foot of the Jagged Peak If she was not given Thiollier's Concoction, the Dragon Communion Priestess will drop this item at the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion after Bayle the Dread is defeated.

markers.name: Forked-Tongue Hatchet
markers.desc: This weapon has a 2% chance to be dropped by hatchet-wielding Imps in catacombs in the Realm of Shadow. It can be farmed in the Scorpion River Catacombs.

markers.name: Frenzyflame Perfume Bottle
markers.desc: Found on a corpse inside the Abandoned Church in the southeastern Abyssal Woods.

markers.name: Freyja's Greatsword
markers.desc: This weapon can be obtainable wherever Redmane Freyja dies. If you gave her Freyja's Letter, you can find Freyja's Greatsword on her body after defeating her during the boss against Needle Knight Leda and her allies.

markers.name: Great Katana
markers.desc: Found on a corpse in the lake on the northern Gravesite Plain where the Ghostflame Dragon is fought.

markers.name: Horned Warrior's Greatsword
markers.desc: Can be dropped from the Wind-aspected Horned Warrior towards the end of Enir-Ilim on the bridge to the  Cleansing Chamber Anteroom Site of Grace.

markers.name: Horned Warrior's Sword
markers.desc: This can be obtained by eliminating the Horned Warrior in the swamp at Belurat Tower Settlement. Drops from Horned Warriors who wield them (an easy one to farm is located just up the stairs from the  Small Private Altar Site of Grace in Belurat, Tower Settlement.

markers.name: Igon's Greatbow
markers.desc: Reward for completing Igon's quest, found on his corpse at the Foot of the Jagged Peak near the dueling Jagged Peak Drakes.

markers.name: Lightning Perfume Bottle
markers.desc: Found on a corpse amongst the Lightning Rams north of the Cerulean Coast.

markers.name: Lizard Greatsword
markers.desc: This weapon can be dropped by Lion Imps (2% chance) in the Scorpion River Catacombs and Fog Rift Catacombs.

markers.name: Madding Hand
markers.desc: Madding Hand may be encountered south of the Woodland Trail site of grace in the Abyssal Woods of the Realm of Shadow.

markers.name: Main-gauche
markers.desc: Found inside of Shadow Keep. From the Main Gate Plaza Site of Grace, head up the western stairs and take a right after the first stair, then take a right again in the corridor to arrive in a small room with a Black Knight. The dagger can be found  on a body in the left corner.

markers.name: Maternal Staff
markers.desc: Dropped by Count Ymir, Mother of Fingers in the Cathedral of Manus Metyr, after having slain Metyr, Mother of Fingers.

markers.name: Messmer Soldier's Spear
markers.desc: 2.00% chance to be dropped by spear-wielding Messmer Soldiers, such as the three found at a camp to the west from  Moorth Ruins site of grace.

markers.name: Obsidian Lamina
markers.desc: Location: Enir-Ilim The Obsidian Lamina is acquired at the end of Sir Ansbach's questline. After defeating Promised Consort Radahn, he can be found leaning against one of the arena's walls.

markers.name: Poisoned Hand
markers.desc: Found in the sewers of Belurat, Tower Settlement. The weapon is on the far right side of the poison pond guarded by a Horned Warrior.

markers.name: Rabbath's Cannon
markers.desc: Found in a chest atop Rabbath's Rise northeast of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr in eastern Scadu Altus. To reach it, unseal the Spiritspring by breaking the sealing stones hidden behind the illusory wall on the rise's lower balcony.

markers.name: Smithscript Axe
markers.desc: This weapon can be found at Taylew's Ruined Forge. Follow the path until you reach a crumbled floor. Jump over the gap and turn left to enter a room with a Golem Smith. The axe is at the far end of the room.

markers.name: Smithscript Cirque
markers.desc: It can be looted from a body located by the edge of the sewage waterfall in Ruined Forge of Starfall Past.

markers.name: Smithscript Dagger
markers.desc: Found at Ruined Forge Lava Intake. Proceed normally through the dungeon until you reach the lever that moves the lava pipe and then drop down to the floor below. The dagger can be found behind the Golem Smith.

markers.name: Smithscript Spear
markers.desc: Location: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past On a corpse not far past the entrance. It is found to the right after crossing the bridge in the first room, near the ladder.

markers.name: Spiraltree Seal
markers.desc: Reward for solving "The Sacred Tower" Painting puzzle. It can only be solved after using Messmer's Kindling on the Sealing Tree past Romina, Saint of the Bud.

markers.name: Spirit Glaive
markers.desc: In order to obtain this weapon, you first start at the site of grace at Charo's Hidden Grave and walk through the arch to the northwest, turn right directly after and take the path that ramps up north, follow it to where it meets the edge of the Gravesite Plain and it will be on a grave.

markers.name: Spirit Sword
markers.desc: This weapon can be found in Cerulean Coast, northeast from the  Cerulean Coast West site of grace, the entrance to a triangular ravine can be accessed. It's in the right corner in that lower area, near some demi-humans.

markers.name: Spread Crossbow
markers.desc: Found along the ravine south of the  Castle Front Site of Grace outside Castle Ensis.

markers.name: Stone-Sheathed Sword
markers.desc: Found at an altar in either Fog Rift Catacombs, Ruins of Unte, or Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Since the altar in Fog Rift Catacombs is the most complicated to reach, it's recommended that the sword be taken there so that the later interactions with altars are less time-consuming. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.

markers.name: Swift Spear
markers.desc: Location: Gravesite Plain The weapon can be found lying on a corpse guarded by 3 Messmer Soldiers along the upper road going southeast from the  Castle Front site of grace outside Castle Ensis.

markers.name: Sword of Darkness
markers.desc: Take the Stone-Sheathed Sword or Sword of Light to an altar at either Fog Rift Catacombs or Ruins of Unte. WARNING: Once either the Sword of Darkness or Sword of Light has been acquired, though the two forms can be freely switched between by traveling to their assigned altars, the Stone-Sheathed Sword itself cannot be reacquired until you enter the next new game cycle.

markers.name: Thiollier's Hidden Needle
markers.desc: Acquired from Thiollier after defeating Promised Consort Radahn at the top of Enir-Ilim, but only if you have completed his quest line before reaching Needle Knight Leda in the Cleansing Chamber.

markers.name: Tooth Whip
markers.desc: Found inside the Whipping Hut on the outskirts of Bonny Village, across a rope bridge.

markers.name: Velvet Sword of St. Trina
markers.desc: From the  Fissure Cross Site of Grace in Cerulean Coast, head north and drop down two stone platforms to a cliff lower down. Inside a Putrescent Rotmound-infested cave to the south is the sword, furthest in.

markers.name: Man-serpent's Shield
markers.desc: 4% chance to be dropped by Man-Serpents in Volcano Manor.

markers.name: Pillory Shield
markers.desc: Looted from a corpse inside one of the locked cells within the Gaol Cave in Caelid.

markers.name: Red Thorn Roundshield
markers.desc: Starting gear for the Samurai class. Can be bought from the Nomadic Merchant (Castle Morne Rampart) for 600 Runes.

markers.name: Blue-white Wooden Shield
markers.desc: Found behind a building in Academy Gate Town, in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Rift Shield
markers.desc: Starting gear for the Prisoner class. Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near Bellum Church in Liurnia of the Lakes for  1800 Runes.

markers.name: Smoldering Shield
markers.desc: Looted from a corpse in an low area filled with explosive Living Jars within Volcano Manor.

markers.name: Gilded Iron Shield
markers.desc: Found on a corpse in the graveyard outside the Church of Pilgrimage on the Weeping Peninsula.

markers.name: Spiralhorn Shield
markers.desc: Found on a corpse on a ledge to the northwest of the Ruined Labyrinth Site of Grace in the Uld Palace Ruins in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Marred Leather Shield
markers.desc: Looted from a corpse on the wooden stairs along the exterior wall past the Stormveil Cliffside Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle.

markers.name: Marred Wooden Shield
markers.desc: Stormveil Castle, near the Rampart Tower Site of Grace, by jumping over the crenellations in the area with the Warhawks perched on barrels and dropping down the rampart walls to jutting ledges on the outside cliff.

markers.name: Coil Shield
markers.desc: Found on a corpse within one of the tunnel rooms in Volcano Cave on Mt. Gelmir. Take the tunnel to the right of the chamber past the grace and drop down the ledge to find the tunnel to the shield.

markers.name: Silver Mirrorshield
markers.desc: Found inside the Apostate Derelict, located in Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Twinbird Kite Shield
markers.desc: Dropped by the Deathbird that you encounter at night north of the Leyndell, Royal Capital, northeast of the Hermit Merchant's shack in the Capital Outskirts.

markers.name: Candletree Wooden Shield
markers.desc: Location: Sage's Cave Found in a chest hidden behind an illusory wall in Sage's Cave.

markers.name: Hawk Crest Wooden Shield
markers.desc: Found in Stormveil Castle, in a room that requires a Stonesword Key to open, near the Grafted Scion and the elevator shortcut back up the the Ramparts Site of Grace.

markers.name: Beast Crest Heater Shield
markers.desc: In a chest at a Godrick Knight's camp northeast of the Warmaster's Shack in Stormhill.

markers.name: Blue Crest Heater Shield
markers.desc: Starting gear for the Confessor class. Can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant near Bellum Church for  1500 Runes.

markers.name: Dragon Towershield
markers.desc: Found in Crumbling Farum Azula, guarded by a Banished Knight. From the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace, proceed down to the open area with the already wounded ancient dragon. Drop down a set of ledges to the dragon's left, enter the building and climb a ladder to find the chest.

markers.name: Crucible Hornshield
markers.desc: The Crucible Hornshield is received upon defeating the Crucible Knight at the Siofra Aqueduct, near the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs site of grace.

markers.name: Distinguished Greatshield
markers.desc: Location: Hermit Merchant's Shack Purchased from the Hermit Merchant at the Hermit Merchant's Shack in Capital Outskirts for  5,500 runes.

markers.name: Dragonclaw Shield
markers.desc: Dropped by the Draconic Tree Sentinel boss in Altus Plateau, outside Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Golden Beast Crest Shield
markers.desc: Dropped by the Grafted Scion at the Chapel of Anticipation. If you are not able to defeat it during your first visit, you can reattempt the fight later by going through the "Precipice of Anticipation" sending gate at the Four Belfries.

markers.name: Erdtree Greatshield
markers.desc: Dropped by the Tree Sentinel duo in Altus Plateau at the southern entrance to the Capital Outskirts.

markers.name: Jellyfish Shield
markers.desc: Found on a dead body with four Spirit Jellyfish around it, north of the  Foot of the Four Belfries Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Fingerprint Stone Shield
markers.desc: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds The Fingerprint Stone Shield is found in the platforming segment past the Cathedral of the Forsaken that leads to the Frenzied Flame Proscription. It is guarded by a Nomad.

markers.name: Icon Shield
markers.desc: Looted from a corpse within the Woodfolk Ruins in Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Visage Shield
markers.desc: It can be found in northeast Caelid, in a chest after defeating the Pumpkin Head duo boss in the Caelem Ruins.

markers.name: Spiked Palisade Shield
markers.desc: Looted from a corpse at the feet of a Guardian Golem in the chasm northwest of the Deep Siofra Well in Caelid.

markers.name: Manor Towershield
markers.desc: Found in Stormveil Castle, from the Secluded Cell Site of Grace, head back towards the Living Jars, then follow the wall to the right upon reaching the next level up the ramp. The Tarnished must jump to the windows from the ledge and enter the door to the right afterward. Following this path will lead to a storeroom full of Commoners with the Manor Shield being under the stairs.

markers.name: Ant's Skull Plate
markers.desc: Nokstella, Eternal City Can be found in a chest in a small room found just up the stairs from the city's main Site of Grace.

markers.name: Inverted Hawk Towershield
markers.desc: 1.00% chance to be dropped by greatshield-wielding Fallen Hawk Soldiers in Nokron, Eternal City.

markers.name: Eclipse Crest Greatshield
markers.desc: 4% chance to be dropped by Mausoleum Knights near Wandering Mausoleums, in the Nameless Eternal City and outside the Black Knife Catacombs.

markers.name: Golden Greatshield
markers.desc: 4% chance to be dropped by Leyndell Knights throughout Altus Plateau and in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Haligtree Crest Greatshield
markers.desc: The Haligtree Crest Greatshield has a 4% chance to be dropped by a Haligtree Knight outside the chapel beyond the  Drainage Channel Site of Grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.

markers.name: Lamenting Visage
markers.desc: Found on a corpse within the Lamenter's Gaol behind an illusory wall and a gate needing the Gaol Lower Level Key to unlock.

markers.name: Serpent Crest Shield
markers.desc: Quest: Gravesite Plain, Realm of Shadow The Serpent Crest Shield is rewarded upon completing the "Incursion" Painting puzzle. Travel west from  Greatbridge North site of grace after receiving the item at the Artist's Shack (Gravesite Plain).

markers.name: Shield of Night
markers.desc: Found on a corpse within Bonny Gaol. Before the bridge leading to the drop down to the boss room, there is a jar elevator that leads up to a ledge where the shield can be found inside a broken cell.

markers.name: All-knowing Helm
markers.desc: Location: Leyndell, Ashen Capital All-Knowing Helm is dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing upon his defeat at the Erdtree Sanctuary.

markers.name: Aristocrat Garb
markers.desc: Chance to drop from Wandering Nobles that wear it, such as the Sorcerer type. Two Sorcerer Wandering Nobles can be found to the east and north of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace.

markers.name: All-knowing Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Leyndell, Ashen Capital The  are obtained by defeating Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing at the Erdtree Sanctuary in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

markers.name: Battlemage Robe
markers.desc: A Battlemage enemy drops the entire set the first time you defeat him, directly north of the Road of Iniquity Side Path grace, Altus Plateau, up on a hill behind the bridge where you first meet Goldmask. ru:Одеяние боевого мага

markers.name: Astrologer Robe
markers.desc: Starting gear for the Astrologer class. Purchased from Nomadic Merchant (Liurnia Lake Shore).

markers.name: Beast Champion Armor
markers.desc: Altered version is received upon: Killing the invader Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula.

markers.name: Black Knife Armor
markers.desc: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Bloodhound Knight Armor
markers.desc: Dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave, hidden in a path that you need to drop down to from where the Merciless Chariot drives across. The Bloodhound Knight stands in front of a body carrying the Gelmir Knight Set.

markers.name: Blue Festive Garb
markers.desc: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. ru:Синее праздничное одеяние

markers.name: Bull-goat Armor
markers.desc: Defeat Great Horned Tragoth for the Volcano Manor. ru:Доспех овцебыка

markers.desc: Found in a chest inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave. ru:Тканое одеяние

markers.name: Commoner's Simple Garb
markers.desc: Found on a corpse right next to the Gateside Chamber grace inside Stormveil Castle.

markers.name: Crucible Axe Armor
markers.desc: Received after defeating the Crucible Knight Ordovis & Crucible Knight duo boss inside Auriza Hero's Grave, located on the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Corhyn's Robe
markers.desc: Dropped by Brother Corhyn if killed. If Corhyn's questline was not completed, it will appear at the last spot he was seen after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.

markers.name: Crucible Tree Armor
markers.desc: Found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in Deeproot Depths.

markers.name: Deathbed Dress
markers.desc: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace, located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. ru:Платье спутницы мёртвых

markers.name: Drake Knight Armor
markers.desc: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set.

markers.name: Eye Surcoat
markers.desc: Found on the ground after defeating Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. ru:Накидка (глаз)

markers.name: Festive Garb
markers.desc: Chance to drop from the dancing enemies that wear it in Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. Cannot be altered by yourself or by Boc.

markers.name: Finger Maiden Robe
markers.desc: Found on a corpse inside the Church of Inhibition located in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Fingerprint Armor
markers.desc: Received after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke inside the Lord Contender's Evergaol located on Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.name: Gelmir Knight Armor
markers.desc: Gelmir Hero's Grave, right where the Bloodhound Knight with the Bloodhound Knight set is.

markers.name: Gravekeeper Cloak
markers.desc: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist-type enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

markers.name: Haligtree Crest Surcoat
markers.desc: Chance to drop from Haligtree Soldiers. Easily farmable northeast of Prayer Room grace.

markers.name: High Page Clothes
markers.desc: Chance to drop from High Page enemies that wear it, such as the one near the West Capital Rampart site of grace in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Highwayman Cloth Armor
markers.desc: Chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as the ones inside Murkwater Cave located in Limgrave. ru:Одеяние разбойника с большой дороги

markers.name: Hoslow's Armor
markers.desc: Reward for completing an NPC invasion of the Volcano Manor questline that sends you to the Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.name: Juvenile Scholar Robe
markers.desc: Location: Liurnia of the Lakes The Juvenile Scholar Robe is acquired upon interacting with the Painter Spirit found in the graveyard outside Caria Manor, southeast of the  Behind Caria Manor Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes.

markers.name: Lionel's Armor
markers.desc: Found on a corpse right next to the Lower Capital Church site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Lusat's Robe
markers.desc: Complete Sellen's questline, then return to the spot where you found Lusat in the Sellia Hideaway cave to loot the Lusat armor set.

markers.name: Malformed Dragon Armor
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel enemy right after the Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula. ru:Уродливый драконий доспех

markers.desc: Found on a corpse alongside with the rest of the set inside Seethewater Cave located in Mt. Gelmir. ru:Гриб (торс)

markers.name: Night's Cavalry Armor
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Night's Cavalry duo boss in Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Nomadic Merchant's Finery
markers.desc: Found behind breakable decor after the Cathedral of the Forsaken site of grace located in Leyndell, Royal Capital. Requires using a Nomadic Merchant enemy to destroy it using his frenzied flame attack.

markers.name: Noble's Traveling Garb
markers.desc: Found on one of the corpses near the East Windmill Pasture in Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Official's Attire
markers.desc: Hidden within a room that you can only reach from the elevator ride that leads down to the Forbidden Lands grace. ru:Официальная одежда

markers.name: Omenkiller Robe
markers.desc: Received upon defeating an Omenkiller inside the Perfumer's Ruins located in Altus Plateau. ru:Одеяние убийцы знамений

markers.name: Old Aristocrat Gown
markers.desc: Dropped by the Wandering Noble wearing the cowl, walking with a large banner and bearing a horn. There are two in the vicinity of the Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One will be up the hill to the east, and the other will be north along the road. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass will allow the Tarnished to kill the noble uncontested. ru:Платье старого аристократа

markers.name: Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak
markers.desc: Dropped by the Putrid Grave Warden Duelist boss in the Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs.

markers.name: Raptor's Black Feathers
markers.desc: Location: Sage's Cave The  is found inside a chest behind an illusory wall in the Sage's Cave, located in Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Scaled Armor
markers.desc: Defeat Old Knight Istvan for the Volcano Manor.

markers.name: Sanguine Noble Robe
markers.desc: Received upon defeating the Sanguine Noble invader, near the white trees in the northwestern Consecrated Snowfield. ru:Одеяние кровавого аристократа

markers.desc: Found on a corpse on a broken Great Coffin, located near the Abandoned Coffin site of grace in Altus Plateau. ru:Одеяние правителя

markers.desc: Can be found on a body inside Stillwater Cave located in Liurnia of the Lakes. ru:Одеяние мудреца

markers.desc: Location: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree The Traveler's Clothes are looted from the rotflower in the sideroom beside the  Haligtree Roots site of grace.

markers.name: Tree Surcoat
markers.desc: Bought from Nomadic Merchant (Altus Plateau). ru:Накидка (дерево)

markers.name: Upper-class Robe
markers.desc: Bought from the Hermit Merchant in Altus Plateau. Found on a corpse on a balcony in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.desc: Found on a corpse inside Spiritcaller Cave in Mountaintops of the Giants. ru:Доспех Белого тростника

markers.desc: are obtained by completing Sorceress Sellen's questline, then returning to the location of Primeval Sorcerer Azur on Mt. Gelmir to loot the Azur's Set.

markers.desc: Location: Altus Plateau The Battlemage Manchettes are dropped by the Battlemage north of the  Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace in the Altus Plateau, on the hill behind the bridge where Goldmask is first encountered.

markers.name: Zamor Armor
markers.desc: Location: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave Received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, located on the Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.name: Beast Champion Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Beast Champion Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Recusant Bernahl north of the Great Bridge in Crumbling Farum Azula. Alternatively, the Beast Champion Gauntlets can be obtained at the Warmaster's Shack if the player defeats Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy without joining the Recusants at Volcano Manor.

markers.name: Black Knife Gauntlets
markers.desc: The entire set can be found on a corpse under the stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town located in Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Blaidd's Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Three Sisters Blaidd's Gauntlets are obtained after defeating Blaidd the Half-Wolf at Ranni's Rise.

markers.name: Bull-goat Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Bull-Goat Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Great Horned Tragoth at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice after receiving the Letter to Patches.

markers.name: Bloodsoaked Manchettes
markers.desc: Location: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds The Bloodsoaked Manchettes are found on a corpse near the  Underground Roadside Site of Grace in the sewers beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Bloodhound Knight Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Gelmir Hero's Grave The Bloodhound Knight Gauntlets are dropped by a Bloodhound Knight hidden along a side path in Gelmir Hero's Grave, near the corpse holding the Gelmir Knight Set.

markers.name: Chain Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Chain Gauntlets can be purchased from Merchant Kalé for  1,000 runes.

markers.name: Drake Knight Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Crumbling Farum Azula The Drake Knight Gauntlets are found in a chest near the  Dragon Temple Rooftop site of grace, alongside the rest of the Drake Knight Set.

markers.name: Crucible Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Auriza Hero's Grave The Crucible Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Crucible Knight Ordovis and the Crucible Knight in Auriza Hero's Grave in the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Errant Sorcerer Manchettes
markers.desc: Location: Hermit Village The Errant Sorcerer Manchettes are found on a corpse in the Hermit Village near the  Craftsman's Shack in Mt. Gelmir.

markers.name: Gelmir Knight Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Gelmir Hero's Grave The Gelmir Knight Gauntlets are found in Gelmir Hero's Grave, near the Bloodhound Knight that drops the Bloodhound Knight Set.

markers.name: Fingerprint Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Lord Contender's Evergaol The Fingerprint Gauntlets are obtained after defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke in the Lord Contender's Evergaol in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.name: Highwayman Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Highwayman Gauntlets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Highwayman enemies, such as those found in Murkwater Cave in Limgrave.

markers.name: Godskin Noble Bracelets
markers.desc: Part of the Godskin Noble Set, acquired after defeating the Godskin Noble at the Liurnia Tower Bridge.

markers.name: Haligtree Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Haligtree Gauntlets have a 4.00% chance to drop from Haligtree Soldier enemies. They can be easily farmed northeast of the Prayer Room .

markers.name: Iron Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Iron Gauntlets can be purchased from the Nomadic Merchant (Castle Morne Rampart) in the Weeping Peninsula for  1,500 runes.

markers.name: Lusat's Manchettes
markers.desc: Location: Sellia Hideaway Lusat's Manchettes are obtained by completing Sorceress Sellen's questline, then returning to the location where Lusat was found in Sellia Hideaway.

markers.name: Lionel's Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Leyndell, Royal Capital Lionel's Gauntlets are found on a corpse on a bed inside the  Lower Capital Church in Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Malformed Dragon Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Malformed Dragon Gauntlets are obtained by defeating the Draconic Tree Sentinel near the  Beside the Great Bridge site of grace in Crumbling Farum Azula.

markers.name: Mushroom Arms
markers.desc: Location: Seethewater Cave The Mushroom Arms are found on a corpse alongside the rest of the Mushroom Set in Seethewater Cave on Mt. Gelmir.

markers.name: Nox Monk Bracelets
markers.desc: The Nox Bracelets have a 3.00% chance to drop from Nox Monk, Nox Swordstress, and Nox Nightmaiden enemies in Nokron, Eternal City and Nokstella, Eternal City.

markers.name: Noble's Gloves
markers.desc: Location: East Windmill Pasture The Noble's Gloves are found on a corpse near the East Windmill Pasture on the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Night's Cavalry Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Night's Cavalry Gauntlets are obtained by defeating the Night's Cavalry duo in the Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Omenkiller Long Gloves
markers.desc: Location: Perfumer's Ruins The Omenkiller Long Gloves are obtained by defeating the Omenkiller in the Perfumer's Ruins on the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Ronin's Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Mountaintops of the Giants The  are dropped by Shabriri near the  Zamor Ruins Site of Grace if the player kills him or meets the Three Fingers.

markers.name: Tree Sentinel Gauntlets
markers.desc: Location: Auriza Hero's Grave The Tree Sentinel Gauntlets are obtained upon destroying the Merciless Chariots inside Auriza Hero's Grave in the Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Traveler's Manchettes
markers.desc: Location: Haligtree Roots The Traveler's Manchettes are found next to the Haligtree Roots site of grace.

markers.name: Scaled Gauntlets
markers.desc: The Scaled Gauntlets are obtained by defeating Old Knight Istvan as part of the Volcano Manor questline.

markers.name: Aristocrat Hat
markers.desc: The Aristocrat Hat has a 1.50% chance to drop from Wandering Nobles that wear it. Two can be found following a torch bearer immediately north of the  Mistwood Outskirts Site of Grace in east Limgrave.

markers.name: Aristocrat Headband
markers.desc: Chance to drop from the Noble Sorcerers that wear it. Two can be found in the vicinity of the  Agheel Lake South Site of Grace. One to the east up the hill and one along the road to the north. Allowing the Kaiden Sellsword to pass while heading to both groups will allow the Tarnished to kill them uncontested.

markers.name: Zamor Bracelets
markers.desc: Location: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave The  is received upon defeating the Ancient Hero of Zamor boss inside the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, located on the Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.desc: Location: Spiritcaller Cave The  are found on a corpse in the Spiritcaller Cave in the Mountaintops of the Giants.

markers.desc: Drop: Black Dumpling Albinaurics The  has a 0.50% drop rate from fast-crawling Elder Albinaurics that wear it, found only in the Prison Town and Subterranean Inquisition Chamber of Volcano Manor, in Leyndell, Royal Capital, or at Castle Sol.

markers.name: Black Hood
markers.desc: Location: Sage's Cave The Black Hood is looted from a chest behind an illusory wall within Sage's Cave in Altus Plateau.

markers.name: Azur's Glintstone Crown
markers.desc: Location: Primeval Sorcerer Azur Azur's Glintstone Crown is obtained upon completing Sorceress Sellen's questline, then returning to the spot where Azur was found on Mt. Gelmir to loot Azur's Set.

markers.name: Banished Knight Helm
markers.desc: The Banished Knight Helm has a 3.00% chance to drop from Banished Communion Knights that wear it, such as the one near the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid. Cannot be obtained by altering Banished Knight Helm (Altered).

markers.desc: The Beast Champion Helm is dropped by Recusant Bernahl upon defeating his invasion north of the  Beside the Great Bridge Site of Grace in Crumbling Farum Azula. markers.name: Bloodsoaked Mask
markers.desc: Location: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds The Bloodsoaked Mask is found on a corpse near the  Underground Roadside site of grace, located in the sewers beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital.

markers.name: Black Knife Hood
markers.desc: Location: Ordina, Liturgical Town The Black Knife Hood, together with the rest of the Black Knife Set, is looted from a corpse beneath a stairway in Ordina, Liturgical Town, located in northern Consecrated Snowfield.

markers.name: Bloodhound Knight Helm
markers.desc: Location: Gelmir Hero's Grave The Bloodhound Knight Helm is dropped by a Bloodhound Knight in Gelmir Hero's Grave. markers.name: Blue Festive Hood
markers.desc: The Blue Festive Hood has a 1.50% chance to drop from Dominula Dancers that wear it in Dominula, Windmill Village, located in Altus Plateau. The enemies always wield the Celebrant's Sickle.

markers.name: Chain Coif
markers.desc: Location: Church of Elleh The Chain Coif is purchased from Merchant Kalé at the Church of Elleh for  1,000 runes.

markers.name: Bull-goat Helm
markers.desc: Obtained by defeating Great Horned Tragoth during Patches' assassination request in the arena of Magma Wyrm Makar at the Ruin-Strewn Precipice.

markers.name: Commoner's Headband
markers.desc: Location: Temple of Eiglay The  is found on top of the head of a serpent statue in Volcano Manor, right after the  Temple of Eiglay grace.

markers.name: Consort's Mask
markers.desc: Location: Volcano Manor The Consort's Mask is dropped by Tanith, Volcano Manor Proprietress upon her death at the  Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy Site of Grace in Volcano Manor.

markers.name: Crimson Hood
markers.desc: The Crimson Hood becomes available after Roderika becomes a Spirit Tuner or upon the player's arrival at Crumbling Farum Azula. It can be found near the  Rampart Tower Site of Grace in Stormveil Castle. It lies discarded on a mound of corpses in the courtyard adjacent to the room with the Grafted Scion, beneath a hanged troll.

markers.name: Crimson Tear Scarab
markers.desc: Location: Volcano Manor The Crimson Tear Scarab is found on a corpse on a ledge beyond the Temple of Eiglay. To reach it, jump off the bridge where a Man-Serpent is first encountered.

markers.desc: The Crucible Tree Helm is found inside a chest behind the Crucible Knight Siluria boss in the Deeproot Depths.

markers.name: Duelist Helm
markers.desc: Can only be obtained as a rare drop from Duelist enemies in Leyndell, Royal Capital and Altus Plateau. Note that you can not farm the duelist enemies in Leyndell after defeating Maliketh, as they won't spawn at the colosseum anymore.

markers.desc: Crumbling Farum Azula, near the Dragon Temple Rooftop grace down on a ledge to the left inside a treasure chest alongside the rest of the Drake Knight set. ru:Шлем драконьего рыцаря

markers.desc: Found on a corpse behind a Giant Oracle Envoy enemy near the Haligtree Canopy site of grace in Miquella's Haligtree. ru:Корона посланца
